title: Las ideas neoliberales
goal: Read how the Washington Consensus market-reform prescriptions -- fiscal discipline, trade liberalization, privatization -- were adopted by most 1990s Latin American governments after the debt crisis.

items: Explain the TINA premise ("There Is No Alternative") behind the reforms.
List some of the recommendations it included.
Explain why many governments adopted these ideas in the 1990s.
Name leaders such as Menem, Fujimori and Salinas who applied the reform package.
Use en pos de to name a pursued goal.
